author: IGN
description:
NVC’s Rebekah Valentine breaks down the biggest takeaways from her huge Stardew Valley interview with ConcernedApe.

Stardew Valley is 10 years old this month. The popular life/farming simulator made waves when it first dropped on February 26, 2016 on PC, quickly becoming beloved for its loving recreation of some of the best aspects of the old Harvest Moon games, while also determinedly following its own path with elements such as the mines, a much wider variety of crops and animals, and queer relationships. 

#Stardewvalley #nintendo #gaming
title: We Talked to Stardew Valley’s Creator - NVC Clips

author: IGN
description:
What better way to celebrate Avowed's anniversary update than to have developers watch their work get absolutely broken by a speedrunner! In this episode, three members of the Avowed development team react to a 28-minute speedrun by MikeWave. Check out real-time commentary from Obsidian Entertainment's Gabe Paramo (Gameplay Director), Ashwin Kumar (VFX Art Lead), and Lindsay Pimentel (QA Engineer) as they have their minds blown by this incredible speedrun pushing the game to its limits!

author: IGN
description:
It’s been over a decade since we first stepped out of Vault 111, but the Commonwealth looks a lot different in 2026. From the robot-building chaos of Automatron to the moody, faction-driven storytelling of Far Harbor, Bethesda has spent years layering new systems, stories, and even a controversial "Creation Club" onto the base game. Whether you’re a returning Sole Survivor or a newcomer arriving after the hit TV show, there is a mountain of content to catch up on—including the massive Anniversary Edition and the long-awaited Switch 2 port.

In this video, we break down every major addition to Fallout 4 since its 2015 launch. We dive into the paid DLC expansions like Nuka-World and Vault-Tec Workshop, explore the brutal challenges of Survival Mode, and look at how the Next-Gen update transformed the experience for PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC.

#ign #gaming
title: Fallout 4 - Everything Major Added Since Launch

author: IGN
description:
The genre redefining Wes Craven classic Scream turns 30 this year, so what better reason to take a good, long look at the legacy of the slasher classic and, because the movie predates us by just a bit, give the film it's first official IGN review score. In our first Flashback Review, IGN's Clint Gage digs into what the movie did to the horror genre when it first came out, how the camera work is the real hero of the opening scene and the surprising character who might be the key to the whole thing working. Then Clint is joined by fellow head of entertainment reviews, Scott Collura, to talk about Scream's lasting impact, why Wes Craven's New Nightmare was the right idea for the wrong story and how Scream's sequels carried the torch for the original.

Subscribe to IGN for more!
http://www.youtube.com/user/IGNentertainment?sub_confirmation=1

#IGN
title: Scream (1996) Flashback Review
